name: Happy path
description: A goal is planned into a 4-step task graph (two steps run in parallel) and every job succeeds. An approval gate pauses the last step until it is approved.

name: Retries with backoff
description: The provider fails half of its calls. Failed jobs retry with exponential backoff and jitter and eventually succeed; none are lost.

name: Chaos recovery
description: A worker is killed in the middle of a job. Its heartbeat expires, another worker reclaims the job (XAUTOCLAIM) and it completes once in effect.

name: DLQ, approval and replay
description: A job exhausts its retries and lands in the dead-letter queue while an approval gate waits for a click. After the approval the dead job is replayed and succeeds.
